sql: SELECT customer_type, ROUND(AVG(working_days_open), 1) AS avg_working_days FROM caseflow.cases WHERE closed_at >= DATE '2026-08-01' AND closed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY customer_type
explanation: The average working days each application was open, for applications closed from August to October 2026.
assumptions: Includes every closed application: approved, declined and withdrawn
